summary: Successfully tested Memory Match Game 3-lives system implementation. Verified all core lives functionality including: game starts with 3 red hearts, lives decrease on wrong matches with heart color changes (❤️ to 🖤), Game Over screen appears after 3 wrong matches with proper messaging and broken heart emoji, lives reset to 3 on new game and level advancement, correct matches don't reduce lives, and Try Again button functionality.

design_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Cannot update a component (App) while rendering a different component (Timer)' - React setState timing issue
design_issues.impact: No functional impact, but should be addressed for clean console logs

passed_tests: Game starts with 3 lives (3 red hearts ❤️ displayed)
Lives display shows 3 hearts in the UI with Level badge and Timer
When cards don't match, player loses 1 life (verified through 3 wrong matches)
Heart changes from red ❤️ to gray/black 🖤 when lost with proper visual feedback
After 3 wrong matches, Game Over screen displays correctly
Game Over screen shows broken heart emoji 💔 prominently
Game Over screen displays 'GAME OVER!' title with gradient styling
Game Over screen shows 'You ran out of lives!' message
Game Over screen displays the level reached (Level 1 in test)
Try Again button returns to start screen successfully
Lives reset to 3 red hearts when starting new game
Lives reset to 3 red hearts when advancing to next level (Level 1 → Level 2)
Correct matches do NOT reduce lives (verified in Level 2)
Timer continues running when lives are lost (confirmed through screenshots)
Game state properly transitions from playing to gameOver after 3 wrong matches
Level advancement works correctly (Level 1 completed → Level 2 with 6 cards)
Lives display maintains proper styling and positioning throughout gameplay
Game Over screen animations work smoothly with proper broken heart display
Reset button functionality works correctly
All UI elements (Level badge, Lives display, Timer) display correctly together
